title: Produce an executable VCF 9.1 brownfield architecture
prompt:
Produce the executable target architecture for the existing VMware Cloud Foundation estate in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`, reaching VCF 9.1.0.0 without an unsupported upgrade hop. Before designing it, research Broadcom's published compatibility, interoperability, upgrade-path, bill-of-materials, and licensing or entitlement information. Record every source consulted in `research/consulted-sources.md` using one Markdown bullet per source with labeled `Title`, `Publisher`, `Accessed`, `URL`, and `Decision` fields. Each record must include the HTTPS URL, an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` access date, and the decision it informed.

Implement a PowerShell module at `VcfBrownfieldArchitecture/`. Declare the installed `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` and `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` PowerCLI modules as prerequisites; use the SDDC Manager module for live estate discovery and the Installer module's generated model initializers while constructing the target `SddcSpec`. Do not vendor or install VMware modules. Export `Export-VcfEstateInventory` and `New-VcfMigrationPlan`. `Export-VcfEstateInventory` must accept `-Server`, `-Credential`, `-EstateId`, and `-Path`; connect to SDDC Manager; collect the manager, domains, vCenters, NSX clusters, hosts, licensing, releases, and compatibility matrices through the generated SDK commands; and disconnect in all cases. `New-VcfMigrationPlan` must accept `-InventoryPath` and `-OutputPath` and write deterministic JSON.

Write the generated architecture to `out/migration-plan.json`. It must validate against `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`, name every inventoried component with its current version, supported target version or disposition, ordered action, and gates, explicitly select one target topology and reject the otherwise technically compatible topology that the supplied entitlement cannot cover, and encode only supported version hops. Its `targetSddcSpec` must conform to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract and reuse the supplied existing vCenter and the datastore selected by the chosen topology. Treat the supplied inventory, schemas, and specification as read-only inputs. Deliver the module, research record, and machine-checkable plan, not a prose architecture report.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py` for acceptance.
